pool.rule: Every track draws ONLY from tips that (a) the CLEAN retrained models produce - prediction_engine_version resolves to an artifact sha256 listed in a stage of an owner override listed in config/top3_paper_tracks.json clean_override_ids (config/promotion_overrides.json: clean-data-switch-2026-11-09 first / second / final refit, and the all-data models' promotion override once the owner adds it) - and (b) clear the OWNER-APPROVED bars of that league x market: a bars_opt cell IDENTICAL to the cell of TP-2026-11-15-bade2c0b (hash-verified; or a later owner-approved R7 re-check proposal added to config/top3_paper_tracks.json -> approved_proposals), applied from that proposal (config/threshold_applied.json). No global bar, no legacy bar, no pre-repair or v9_repaired model, no unapproved cell. OFF cells give no candidates. MODEL cells only (owner 2026-11-11 "Own list"): a LEAGUE_WIDE cell (source NONE) is shown on its own line outside the TOP-3 slots and never enters the TOP-3 / TIER2 pool of T1, T2 or the live T3.
pool.same_as_production: candidates first seen strictly before FREEZE = the league-week's first kickoff - TOP3_FREEZE_LEAD_MIN (owner: 120 min), two-sided price, at or above the league's own bar; cap 3 per league per gameweek; fewer when fewer qualify (never padded); direction rule against the track's own picks of the week AND the fixture's live production tip; a candidate kicked off before issue is skipped

rules_common.per_league: Every statistic is per cell = (track, league, market-side), from that cell's own data, shrunk at most toward the SAME league's other markets. No cross-league pooling, no global constant.
rules_common.missing_statistic: missing-statistic fallback for EVERY rule, never ev_est: (1) the rule's own key; (2) LIVE_KEY - the live rule's key (R2 since v6) when the rule is not the live rule and it has one; (3) CELL_EB - the cell's frozen walk-forward ROI shrunk within the league; (4) KICKOFF - kickoff time, then fixture id. A tip without the rule's statistic still ranks after every tip that has one. Ties inside a group: kickoff, then fixture id (ev_est no longer breaks ties either). Each pick records rank_basis.

tracks.ledger: output/top3_league_ledger.csv (the production TOP-3, ranked by R2 = LIVE_RULE; each pick shows its R2 calibrated edge)
tracks.rule: (fair + lam * (p_used - fair)) * odds - 1; lam = least squares slope of (won - fair) on (p_used - fair) over the cell's own priced rows (>= MIN_OWN_BETS), shrunk toward the same league's other markets (DerSimonian-Laird), clipped to [0, 1]
as T2 with lam_lo = clip(lam - Z95 * se_own(lam), 0, 1)

live_statistics.remeasurement: ONE re-freeze allowed (owner 2026-11-15): after the all-data models are promoted, scripts/top3_paper_freeze.py --remeasure freezes the statistics again from those models' walk-forward predictions (their frame listed in config/top3_paper_tracks.json clean_frames and all_data_models, universes rebuilt on it, rows dated before the re-measurement day) BEFORE the first pick under them; it refuses once any live or paper pick carries an all-data engine version. paper_tracking.start: league-weeks whose FREEZE is on or after 2026-11-21T00:00:00Z
paper_tracking.unit: 1 flat unit per pick at the price recorded at first sight; T1/T2 paper only, labelled PAPER/RESEARCH, never staked, executed or published
paper_tracking.settlement: the production TOP-3 settlement (src.top3_league.settle_picks rules: graded from the results feed after the settle delay; production void rules)
paper_tracking.ledger: one row per (track, league-week, rank), written once at FREEZE, frozen columns hash-checked on settlement

evaluation.tested_once: Each track is tested exactly once: at look 1 if it has >= 150 settled picks then, else at look 2. Below 150 at look 2 -> INCONCLUSIVE (its p counts as 1 in Holm). No other looks.
evaluation.statistic: ROI over the track's settled picks; one-sided p = src.league_bars.one_sided_p (bootstrap over match dates, N_BOOT, seed 0); 95% CI = src.bars_opt.study.score
evaluation.family: Holm (src.league_bars.holm) over the 2 tracks T2 (LIVE, R2) and T3 (PAPER, R3); at look 1 a track not yet tested counts as p = 1; at look 2 the final Holm uses each track's single test.
evaluation.pass: n >= 150 AND Holm-adjusted p < 0.025 one-sided AND 95% CI lower bound > 0
evaluation.secondary_descriptive: paired league-week differences between tracks, CLV when graded, realised minus p_used, mix, no_stat picks. Never a pass criterion.
evaluation.consequence: The owner decides. Nothing switches automatically.
